title: Accelerated fixture-only quest progression

identity.purpose: fast deterministic test fixture; never a persistent campaign character

acceleration.meaning: 1000% of baseline pacing, exactly 10x; this is not a production XP-rate change

exact_target_instant_kill.supported_only_when: a server capability probe and fixture adapter both report exact_target_fixture_kill=true

preparation.purpose: Seed a fresh quest fixture and acceleration policy without touching quest status or reward state.
steps: Allocate one wayfarer/out-of-roster character with no campaign ownership.
Seed only level/spec/gear, quest giver context, exact objectives, and the fixture pacing lease.
Seed a position only as setup; native route and interaction remain the proof surface.
Require questlog absence, no rewarded row, and zero objective progress before operation.
Refuse the run if the server cannot attest to the requested 10x fixture pacing and exact target capability.

operation.purpose: Run normal quest acquisition and objective execution at accelerated fixture pacing.
operation.priority_policy: the exact quest may be leased as highest priority only; the lease cannot grant, complete, or reward it
native_evidence_required: normal acceptance through the giver and positive acceptance evidence
questlog contains the exact quest after acceptance
objective counters increase only after native kill, loot, or interaction evidence
exact-target instant-kill, if used, is followed by native combat/loot/quest credit receipts
completion and reward remain native questlog/acceptance observations; XP or movement alone is insufficient

postconditions.predicate: 10x pacing is present only under the fixture lease and is absent from campaign/runtime configuration
progress delta is attributable to the exact objective and native event
accepted, complete, and rewarded states are observed from the server; none are inserted or inferred

current_bridge_can_prove: native combat and interaction receipts when emitted
adapter_still_needed: exact-target instant-kill capability for kill objectives
adapter_boundary.not_an_adapter_goal: A direct quest-status or reward writer must never be introduced as a proof shortcut.

cleanup: leave quest state native or reset only through a separate fixture reset protocol
